# Get pending payment requests received this month (May 2023). We'll fetch all pages.

page = 0
all_pending = []
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status='pending', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if isinstance(resp, list):
        all_pending.extend(resp)
        if len(resp) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    else:
        print("Error:", resp)
        break
print("Total pending requests:", len(all_pending))
# Filter for May 2023
may_requests = [r for r in all_pending if r['created_at'].startswith('2023-05')]
print("Pending requests in May:", len(may_requests))
for r in may_requests:
    print(r)
